type Raw string
type PageOutcome uint32
const PageOutcomePage
const PageOutcomeGap
const PageOutcomeUnavailable
const PageOutcomeInvalidRequest
const PageOutcomeRecordTooLarge
const PageOutcomeCorrupt
const PageOutcomeUnsupported
func (PageOutcome) String() string
func (PageOutcome) WireName() (string, bool)
func ParsePageOutcome(word string) (PageOutcome, bool)
func (PageOutcome) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)
func (PageOutcome) UnmarshalText(text []byte) error
func (PageOutcome) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
func (PageOutcome) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error
func PageOutcomeValues() []PageOutcome
func (PageOutcome) Known() bool
type ServiceErrorCode string
const ServiceErrorCodeHandlerError
const ServiceErrorCodeInvalidResult
const ServiceErrorCodeUnknownVersion
const ServiceErrorCodeUnknownService
const ServiceErrorCodeUnknownMethod
const ServiceErrorCodeWrongMode
const ServiceErrorCodeCallerUnavailable
const ServiceErrorCodeIdentityRequired
const ServiceErrorCodeWrongUser
const ServiceErrorCodePolicyUnavailable
const ServiceErrorCodeForbidden
func ServiceErrorCodeValues() []ServiceErrorCode
func (ServiceErrorCode) Known() bool
var HistoryErrorCodes
var HistoryCursorWords
type Attestation struct
  By string
  Verified bool
  Hop int64
  Program string
  Host string
  User string
  Exe string
  UID int64
  GID int64
  PID int64
  Key string
  Mac string
type Record struct
  Schema int64
  Time string
  Level int64
  Msg string
  Identity []Attestation
  Job string
  Attrs map[string]string
type Page struct
  Outcome PageOutcome
  Records []Record
  Next string
  AtEnd bool
func Encode(v *Record) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Record, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
func ServiceName(frame []byte) (string, error)
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type Sink interface
  Write(record Record) error
type SinkTransport interface
  FrameWriter
type SinkClient struct
func NewSinkClient(t SinkTransport) *SinkClient
type SinkDispatcher struct
  Handler Sink
func (SinkClient) Write(record Record) (err error)
func (SinkDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (SinkDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (SinkDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type HistoryReader interface
  Read(cursor string, maxRecords, maxBytes int64) (Page, error)
type HistoryReaderTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type HistoryReaderClient struct
func NewHistoryReaderClient(t HistoryReaderTransport) *HistoryReaderClient
type HistoryReaderDispatcher struct
  Handler HistoryReader
func (HistoryReaderClient) Read(cursor string, maxRecords, maxBytes int64) (result Page, err error)
func (HistoryReaderDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (HistoryReaderDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (HistoryReaderDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (HistoryReaderDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type HistoryObserver interface
  Observe(cursor string, maxRecords, maxBytes, waitMs int64) (Page, error)
type HistoryObserverTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type HistoryObserverClient struct
func NewHistoryObserverClient(t HistoryObserverTransport) *HistoryObserverClient
type HistoryObserverDispatcher struct
  Handler HistoryObserver
func (HistoryObserverClient) Observe(cursor string, maxRecords, maxBytes, waitMs int64) (result Page, err error)
func (HistoryObserverDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (HistoryObserverDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (HistoryObserverDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (HistoryObserverDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
